senses.gloss:
गेह n. (-हं) A house, a dwelling.
 E. ग a name of GANESHA इह् to desire,
affix घञ्; that deity being usually invoked upon laying the found-
ations of a house.

गेहनर्द्दिन् m. (-र्द्दी) A lazy or effeminate man, a cotquean.
 E. गेह a house,
and नर्द्दिन् who makes a noise: see the next.

गेहशूर m. (-रः) A slothful and trifling man, one who is unfit for con-
cerns beyond those of the house, a cotquean, a house-hero.
 E. गेह a
house, and शूर a hero.

गेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Having a house, householder, &c.
 E. गेह, and
इनि aff.
